elements.element: Vendor (SFJ) indemnity against third-party claims that services/deliverables infringe third-party IP
elements.evidence: "SFJ will indemnify the PB Indemnified Parties ... any Claim by a Third Party alleging that the services or deliverables provided by SFJ under this Agreement infringe or misappropriate such Third Party's Intellectual Property"
"except to the extent such Claim arises from modifications made by PB"

elements.element: Exclusion for combinations with items not supplied by Vendor
elements.evidence: "combination of such services or deliverables by PB with items not supplied by SFJ"

elements.element: Exclusion for Vendor's compliance with Customer specifications
elements.evidence: "or SFJ's compliance with specifications provided by PB"

elements.element: Remedy: procure right to continue use
elements.evidence: "procure for PB the right to continue using the infringing item"

elements.element: Remedy: refund if other remedies unavailable
elements.evidence: "if none of the foregoing is available on commercially reasonable terms, refund the amounts paid for it"

elements.element: Super-cap of 3× annual fees on the Vendor indemnity
elements.evidence: "SFJ's aggregate liability under this Section 12.1.3 will not exceed 3x the annual fees payable under this Agreement"

elements.element: Vendor defends (not merely indemnifies) Customer and affiliates
elements.evidence: Insert says only "SFJ will indemnify the PB Indemnified Parties"; no defence obligation added

elements.element: Indemnity coverage for Vendor's breach of law
elements.evidence: 12.1.1 heads are limited to "(a) the gross negligence or willful misconduct of SFJ ...", clinical injury and product liability; no breach-of-law head

elements.element: Indemnity coverage for data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: No data breach head appears in 12.1.1 or the inserted 12.1.3

elements.element: Indemnity coverage for Vendor gross negligence/wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "(a) the gross negligence or willful misconduct of SFJ or any of its Affiliates"
Section 12.2.1 is referenced by definitions ("Indemnified Party" has the meaning ascribed ... in Section 12.2.1") but its text is not supplied

elements.element: Customer's indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: 12.1.2 remains broad: "(a) a Product supplied by PB ... (f) actual or alleged infringement of any Third Party's Intellectual Property by the Product or by either Party"

reasons: The inserted Section 12.1.3 delivers every atomic element of the fallback: an SFJ IP infringement indemnity for the PB Indemnified Parties, the three usual exclusions (PB modifications, PB combinations, PB specifications), the full procure/modify/replace/refund remedy ladder, and a 3× annual fees super-cap.

Minimality is satisfied: no existing sentence was altered, deleted or duplicated; a concise new subsection was added where no Vendor IP indemnity existed, and the numbering (12.1.3) matches the internal cross-reference in the cap.

Preferred is not met and was not targeted: no express defence obligation, no breach-of-law or Vendor data-breach heads, and PB's own broad indemnity in 12.1.2 (including the two-way IP infringement head (f)) is left untouched rather than narrowed to PB-provided content and PB's breach of law.

Note for the rationale, not a deviation: "annual fees payable under this Agreement" is not a defined concept in this co-development agreement (which speaks in Development Costs), so the quantum of the super-cap may be uncertain; consider tying it to a defined payment metric to avoid an arguably nil cap on our own indemnity.
